title: Undefined variable 'bitrate' in strict filesize constraint path
description: encode() at L1779-1780 references 'bitrate' which is not defined. The correct variable is 'video_bitrate'. This causes a runtime error (nil + 'k' string concatenation) when strict_filesize_constraint=true and target_filesize>0.

title: formats['raw'] is nil - crash in EncodeOptionsPage instantiation
description: EncodeOptionsPage.__init includes 'raw' in formatIds (L2368) but formats['raw'] is never registered. Accessing formats['raw'].displayName at L2380 crashes with nil indexing error.

title: options.output_format default 'mp4 (h264/AAC)' does not match any formats key
description: The default value 'mp4 (h264/AAC)' at L17 does not match the registry key 'mp4'. encode() at L1698 would return nil format on first use, causing a crash on the first getCodecFlags() call.

title: get_duration uses undefined local 'reversed_binary_duration'
description: FirstpassStats.get_duration() at L620 uses 'reversed_binary_duration' instead of the local 'big_endian_binary_duration'. Would crash if called. Not called in normal flow (only set_duration is used).

title: startEncode appends empty table (vestigial no-op)
description: EncodeWithProgress.startEncode at L1365-1366 calls append(copy_command_line, {}) which is a no-op. Vestigial artifact, harmless but dead code.

title: mpv-webm-set-options IPC handler has no input validation
description: test_set_options() accepts any JSON blob and merges all keys into the global options table without validation. Any script with mpv IPC access can inject arbitrary option values including additional_flags.

title: Temp file and logfile leaked when run_detached=true
description: encode() at L1856 returns early via subprocess_detached without cleaning up the VP8 pass1 logfile or the HLS cache_dump.ts temp file.

title: strict_bitrate_multiplier option declared but never used
description: options.strict_bitrate_multiplier = 0.95 is declared at L15 and read by mpopts.read_options but never referenced in any calculation. Dead option.

title: additional_flags whitespace tokenization breaks values with spaces
description: additional_flags is split by gmatch('[^%s]+') at L1790. Any flag value containing a space is split into multiple tokens, corrupting the argument.

title: PreviewPage saves properties at construction, not show() time
description: PreviewPage.__init saves vf/time-pos/pause at L2593-2597 during construction. If mpv properties change between construction and show(), those changes are incorrectly captured as 'original' values.
